prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Burgundy and Rose: page #FFF8FA, text #48232E, accent #9D244E, secondary surface #F7DBE5, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in League Gothic and reading text in Libre Baskerville; condensed display heading with reading serif. Composition: Chronological entries with dates on a shared rail, compact media, explicit sequence. Use body 20px, heading 64px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
